description: Add a single item with an exact title, optionally with a date. The title is stored EXACTLY as given — nothing rewrites or shortens it. Use this whenever the user has settled on wording: they put it in quotes, they dictated it, or you are copying something verbatim. Quotation marks in particular mean "these words" — use this tool and pass what is inside them, and put any date in targetDate rather than leaving it in the title. Use capture instead only when the user is talking loosely and wants tidee to work out the wording, the boxes and the dates for them.

parentId.description: Box id to file it in. Ids come from list_boxes.

targetDate.description: When the user should DO this, as local time with no timezone: "2026-09-10T09:00:00". Not the date of an event the task is merely about — "book a table for the 14th" needs doing before the 14th, so leave it out and let the user choose. Default to 09:00 when no time was given. Omit when no date was mentioned.

title.description: The item title, used exactly as given.

name: create_item
title: Create one tidee item
